mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.title, h.description, h.class_id, h.course_id, h.deadline, h.max_score, h.create_time, c.class_name, co.course_name FROM homework h LEFT JOIN class c ON h.class_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course co ON h.course_id = co.id AND co.is_deleted = 0 WHERE h.id = #{id} AND h.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO homework (title, description, class_id, course_id, deadline, max_score) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{classId}, #{courseId}, #{deadline}, #{maxScore})
mapper.update: UPDATE homework SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, deadline = #{deadline}, max_score = #{maxScore} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE homework SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE homework_submission SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM homework_submission WHERE homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName, hs.id, hs.submit_status AS submitStatus, hs.submit_time AS submitTime, hs.score, hs.comment FROM student s LEFT JOIN homework_submission hs ON s.id = hs.student_id AND hs.homework_id = #{homeworkId} AND hs.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO homework_submission (homework_id, student_id, submit_status, submit_time) VALUES (#{homeworkId}, #{studentId}, #{submitStatus}, #{submitTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE submit_status = VALUES(submit_status), submit_time = VALUES(submit_time)
mapper.select: SELECT id, homework_id, student_id, submit_status, submit_time, score, comment FROM homework_submission WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
